propositions: When file_impact is undeclared, scope fail-safe SHA-drift invalidation to read-set and blast-radius paths instead of invalidating on any code-SHA change.

Normalize observed fetch telemetry (distinct_fetches from usage_log.run_shape) to a deduplicated, repo-relative read-set by filtering to read_file calls, resolving paths, dropping non-existent files and outside-repo escapes, and sorting.
Record the normalized read-set in the signed manifest as sorted read-path lines plus a read-set count marker, binding it to the signature so modification fails verification.

Compose dependency_hashes from read-set union blast-radius globs (criteria, workflow, reviewer configs) using shared hash_dep_entry logic that expands globs to individual entries and records membership digests for addition/deletion coverage.

Apply read-set scoping only when pre-existing file_impact set is empty, container poison rule is off, scope is undeclared (not authenticated none), and a read-set was recorded; exclude already-scoped, poisoned, or declared-none sets to prevent widening or reclassification.
Report currency-basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) in signed manifest and status output; unverifiable read-set or expansion failure falls back to invalidate-on-any-change.
